verdict.rationale: Elicit runs its own Research Agent, so being an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Elicit exposed as an MCP server for external clients such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code, which is the opposite role. Nothing documents Elicit's agent connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
